GAP_IDENTIFIED.defect: the parent permuted FULL_REGULAR dates ARBITRARILY across the whole DEV period
GAP_IDENTIFIED.implicit_assumption: date blocks are exchangeable across the entire DEV period, conditional on session_length_class
GAP_IDENTIFIED.why_that_is_strong: volatility / regime / market structure change over time. ATR normalisation reduces the problem but does NOT establish exchangeability.
GAP_IDENTIFIED.worked_example: a claim concentrated in a 2022 regime, whose Y_ATR distribution also differs in 2022, would have its 2022 Y blocks thrown into 2025 under the null — cross-sectional dependence preserved, TEMPORAL dependence destroyed
GAP_IDENTIFIED.why_the_smoke_could_not_catch_it: the synthetic Y was constructed by us, so temporal exchangeability held there by construction
GAP_IDENTIFIED.status_of_parent: the parent's cross-sectional guarantees remain correct and are RETAINED

FULL_REGULAR.rule: within each calendar year-month independently, ONE uniform cyclic offset per draw
FULL_REGULAR.construction: pi(idx[i]) = idx[(i + offset_m) % k], where idx = that month's ordered FULL_REGULAR dates

EARLY_CLOSE.why: only 10 such dates across 5 years; permuting them freely would reinstate exactly the exchangeability problem this amendment fixes
EARLY_CLOSE.they_remain: in the primary population and in observed theta

STATED_LIMITATION_EARLY_CLOSE_IDENTITY.consequence: those episodes contribute the SAME value to theta_obs and to every theta^(b); s_j therefore measures the variability of the RANDOMISED FULL part only
STATED_LIMITATION_EARLY_CLOSE_IDENTITY.coherence: the fixed contribution appears in both theta_obs and c_j and largely cancels in the numerator
STATED_LIMITATION_EARLY_CLOSE_IDENTITY.honest_direction: the residual pressure is ANTI-conservative and is bounded by the 0.805% share — recorded as a number, NOT dismissed as negligible

NEW_GUARDS.guard_time_locality: pi(d) must lie in the SAME calendar month as d, for FULL dates
NEW_GUARDS.guard_cyclic_structure: within a month the offset must be CONSTANT — an arbitrary within-month permutation is a violation
NEW_GUARDS.guard_early_close_identity: pi(d) == d for every EARLY_CLOSE date

NEW_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES.N4_parent_map: the PARENT's global map itself FAILS guard_time_locality — confirming the amendment is substantive, not cosmetic
